ACT I

SCENE I. A garden.

GARDENER.
Consider now the ordering of a garden,
which is a commonwealth in little compass.
The gravel walk divides it into quarters;
each quarter has its office and its season.

APPRENTICE.
And which among them do you hold the chief?

GARDENER.
None and all. The question is ill framed.
A garden is not governed by its best part
but by the part that fails, and when it fails.
Attend upon the weakest of the four
and the remainder will attend themselves.
